task_summary: Interpret and follow technical drawings, blueprints, and assembly instructions to assemble components accurately. Select, prepare, and fit parts using hand tools, power tools, or automated equipment. Assemble mechanical, mechatronic, or vehicle components and systems according to specifications. Adjust or troubleshoot components and assemblies to meet operational and quality requirements. Document assembly processes, test results, and issues for records and reporting. Maintain a safe, clean, and organised workspace throughout the assembly process. Collaborate with engineers and quality teams to improve assembly processes and ensure compliance.
